description: Paste a run_id, request_id, or job_id to reconstruct the timeline.

panels.description: Full correlated log stream for the selected ids.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  timestamp,
  level,
  event,
  component,
  stage,
  status,
  duration_ms,
  message,
  run_id,
  request_id,
  job_id
FROM route_agent_observability.logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND (empty('${run_id:raw}') OR run_id = '${run_id:raw}') AND (empty('${request_id:raw}') OR request_id = '${request_id:raw}') AND (empty('${job_id:raw}') OR job_id = '${job_id:raw}')
ORDER BY timestamp
LIMIT 500

panels.title: Timeline

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  timestamp,
  JSONExtractString(extra, 'kind') AS kind,
  stage,
  status,
  JSONExtractString(extra, 'detail') AS detail,
  run_id,
  request_id
FROM route_agent_observability.logs
WHERE event LIKE 'pipeline_event_%' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND (empty('${run_id:raw}') OR run_id = '${run_id:raw}') AND (empty('${request_id:raw}') OR request_id = '${request_id:raw}') AND (empty('${job_id:raw}') OR job_id = '${job_id:raw}')
ORDER BY timestamp
LIMIT 200

SELECT
  timestamp,
  event,
  JSONExtractString(extra, 'method') AS method,
  JSONExtractString(extra, 'path') AS path,
  JSONExtractInt(extra, 'status_code') AS status_code,
  duration_ms,
  run_id,
  job_id,
  request_id
FROM route_agent_observability.logs
WHERE event IN ('http_request','http_response','job_queued','job_running','job_completed','job_failed')
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND (empty('${run_id:raw}') OR run_id = '${run_id:raw}') AND (empty('${request_id:raw}') OR request_id = '${request_id:raw}') AND (empty('${job_id:raw}') OR job_id = '${job_id:raw}')
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 100
